subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@aurelia-tech.com>, Alice Jones <alice.jones@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery

Hi Tom / Alice - great call earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick post-call recap and next steps (MAP v0.1 attached):

Summary of agreed milestones (high level)
- 11/12: Aurelia completes our SOC 2 questionnaire (we'll fill parts we own).
- 11/19: Exchange of evidence / access where applicable (logs, config screenshots, attestations).
- 11/26: Final security review sign-off and target close for procurement (subject to no outstanding items).

Responsibilities
- Redwood (Marissa, Neha): deliver SOC 2 questionnaire, evidence index, and packaged SOC materials; coordinate any evidence exports.
- Aurelia (Tom, Alice, security team): provide requested evidence or access, confirm timelines, and raise blockers early.
- Internal: Rishi will compile requested artifacts and be the primary technical contact for evidence collection.

Dependencies / blockers
- SSO/Okta admin access for audit logs (Aurelia to grant read-only service account).
- Scheduled network vulnerability scan report (Aurelia to provide scan window or share results).

Next steps
1) Confirm the above dates and owners by end of day tomorrow.
2) Aurelia: download the attached MAP_draft_v1.pdf and reply with any changes to milestones or target close.
3) Redwood: send the questionnaire + evidence index by COB Monday (11/09 PST).

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP outline + timeline)

Thanks - I'll follow up with an updated MAP with exact filenames and delivery dates once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from Aurelia security: 

1) Can you send the SOC 2 questionnaire as an editable spreadsheet? We prefer to annotate rather than edit PDFs.
2) For "evidence access" - our security team will need a concrete list of required artifacts (log ranges, config screen grabs, user lists). Can you provide an evidence index?
3) Proposed timeline: questionnaire back to you by 11/12 (OK), but evidence collection might slip to 11/20 depending on our security team calendar. Is that acceptable for target close?

Looping in security@aurelia-tech.com for technical questions. Also, please include your security/infosec lead on the evidence list; we want a single Redwood point of contact.

Thanks,
Tom Chen
Director, IT Security | Aurelia Tech
Tom.Chen@aurelia-tech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@aurelia-tech.com>, Alice Jones <alice.jones@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery

Tom - perfect, thanks for the questions. Per your asks, attaching the editable files and an evidence index so your team can review. See updated MAP milestones below (MAP v0.2 attached):

Updated milestones / deadlines (MAP v0.2)
- 2026-11-12: Aurelia returns completed questionnaire (Aurelia_SOC2_questionnaire.xlsx) - owner: Aurelia security (Tom).
- 2026-11-19: Redwood delivers compiled SOC2 package to Aurelia (SOC2-package-20261119.zip) - owner: Marissa / Neha.
- 2026-11-20: Aurelia provides any missing evidence or access (evidence_access_list.csv will help track) - owner: Aurelia security.
- 2026-11-26: Final security review & sign-off (target close) - owner: both parties (confirm on 11/24).

Files attached / included
- Aurelia_SOC2_questionnaire.xlsx (editable)
- evidence_access_list.csv (one-row-per-artifact tracker: artifact, owner, due date, access details)
- MAP_draft_v0.2.pdf (updated milestones + responsibilities)

Key dependencies
- Okta/SSO read-only logs: please provide a service account or a secure export window.
- Vulnerability scan: a copy of the latest report or confirmation of scheduled scan date.
- Timezone sensitivity: our internal evidence collection team (Rishi) is on PST. If Aurelia runs scans in CET windows, call it out and we'll coordinate.

If the 11/19 package delivery and 11/26 close still looks tight for your schedule, propose a revised target and we'll map resources internally.

Attachments (stubs): Aurelia_SOC2_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence_access_list.csv (CSV), MAP_draft_v0.2.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery

All - quick internal alignment. We can meet the internal deliverables with the following owners and timeline: 

- Marissa / Neha: prepare SOC2-package-20261119.zip (includes filled questionnaire, copy of our SOC 2 report, process docs, and evidence pointers) - deliverable ready by 11/19 EOD PST.
- Rishi: collect sysadmin artifacts (access logs, rotation policies, MFA screenshots) by 11/17 to enable packaging.
- Neha: validate contracts/PSA language for audit access and ensure the MAP notes a 30-day evidence retention window.

Dependencies we need Aurelia to confirm ASAP:
- Provide Okta read-only service account or export share by 11/12.
- Confirm vulnerability scan timing or share the last report by 11/15.

Marissa - suggest we send the SOC2-package link (DRIVE stub) to Aurelia on 11/19 and schedule a 30-minute review on 11/24 to walk through any items before the 11/26 target close. Tom - does that calendar work for you?

-Ben
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

On 2026-11-10T09:45:00-08:00 Tom Chen <tom.chen@aurelia-tech.com> wrote:
> Ben / Marissa - 11/19 delivery and 11/24 review look fine from our side. We will aim to have evidence ready by 11/20 and will confirm the Okta export by 11/12. Appreciate the clear owners.
> 
> -Tom
